resolved_conflicts.explanation: MountainZone gives 3,153 ft (961 m) and SOTA gives 3170 feet. The story reports both and does not choose.
The FFLA entry and the record say Roanoke; SOTA lists Franklin & Roanoke. The story names both.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA list mentions a tower here. No build, use or removal source found. A Reddit thread (r/roanoke, Masons Knob hiking post) says the knob is private land with posted signs; fetch_text returned no text, so it is not cited and access is left out of the story. anyplaceamerica.com returned 403. The MountainZone and SOTA heights differ by 17 ft. The record's Roanoke county matches FFLA; SOTA gives both counties. Access unknown; do not suggest a visit without a source for the land status.
